verdict: NO FLOW: no water ever crosses the crest. The trickle is lost before the notch (check the wet/dry threshold, the upstream boundary and the initial water surface).
TRICKLE AT THE WET/DRY LIMIT: depth on the downstream face never exceeds 2 x h_dry (2 mm), so shear there is set to zero or near zero.
BELOW THRESHOLD: grain shear on the crest/face never reaches critical (max tau/tau_c = 0.00).
SUPPLY RUNS OUT: lake head over the notch fell to -10.9 mm before the notch deepened, so the feedback (deeper notch -> more flow) never starts.
NOTCH FILLED IN: the notch invert rose by up to 31 mm (sediment or collapsed notch walls), which can block the trickle.
